title: Rabbi Yonah bar Abba

paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Vayikra Rabbah chapter 35, reporting Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman calls this a scribal error: the statement should read as in Taanit, chapter 3, halakhah 9, Rabbi Yonah (in the name of) Shimon bar Ba, in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. Shimon was omitted by mistake.

notes.text: The missing Shimon is an intermediate tradent, not a new father. The source’s parenthesized “in the name of” remains parenthesized.

The consulted Vayikra Rabbah reads Yonah bar Abba. The Yerushalmi places Yonah and Shimon bar Ba together and explicitly names Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman supplies the first “in the name of” in parentheses.
